Fix double quote escape issue in python script writing to execute cleanly.
```python
code_content = """
p1 = 1/3
p2 = 1/3 * p1 + 1/3 * 1 + 1/3 * p1
p3 = 1/3 * p2 + 1/3 * p1 + 1/3 * 1

print(f"Position 1 win probability: {p1:.5f} ({1}/3)")
print(f"Position 2 win probability: {p2:.5f} ({5}/9)")
print(f"Position 3 win probability: {p3:.5f} ({17}/27)")
"""

res = await run_command(f'python3 -c "{code_content}"')
print(res)
```
